planName: California Medi-Cal managed care (21 and over)
population: Adults in Medi-Cal managed care, including the ACA expansion, seniors and persons with disabilities, and long-term care members (carved in statewide)
notes: No deductible or coinsurance. Pregnant and postpartum members get full-scope coverage for 12 months postpartum.

benefits.limitations: Statute allows a $1 copayment per visit (W&I §14134); this template uses $0. A provider cannot deny care for nonpayment.
Statute allows a $1 copayment per visit (W&I §14134); this template uses $0. A provider cannot deny care for nonpayment.
Statute allows a $5 copayment for a non-emergency ER visit (W&I §14134); emergencies are exempt. This template uses $0.
Statute allows a $1 copayment per visit (W&I §14134); this template uses $0. A provider cannot deny care for nonpayment.
Non-specialty (mild to moderate) mental health only. Specialty mental health is the county mental health plan; substance use treatment is the county DMC or DMC-ODS program.
Only drugs billed on medical or institutional claims (physician-administered drugs, infusion). Pharmacy-claim drugs are Medi-Cal Rx.

displayBenefits.limitations: Pharmacy-claim drugs are covered by Medi-Cal Rx, not the plan.

carveOuts.service: Outpatient pharmacy (drugs billed on pharmacy claims)
carveOuts.to: Medi-Cal Rx (DHCS fee-for-service); drugs and supplies billed on medical or institutional claims stay with the plan
County mental health plan (MHP); the managed care plan covers non-specialty mental health
Medi-Cal Dental (fee-for-service; dental managed care in some counties)

notModeled.why: Set by each plan within state rules; load as prior-auth rules per plan.

notModeled.item: Nominal copayments ($1 visit, $1 prescription, $5 non-emergency ER)
notModeled.why: Allowed by statute with many exemptions (emergency, family planning, perinatal, inpatients, USPSTF A/B preventive, services under $10) and not collectible as a condition of care; plans generally do not apply them. Left at $0; set per plan if the contract requires.
Carved into managed care statewide; share of cost set by the county is member liability, not a plan cost share.
